searchText: Has any CL implemented getPayloadBodiesByHashV1 and/or getPayloadBodiesByRangeV1? Lighthouse hasn’t yet Neither did prysm fwiw, switching payload body offloading logic to these new methods is not necessarily related to Capella, especially if `eth_getBlockByHash` is featured with `withdrawals` But CL client devs are strongly encouraged to do the switch and stop using a method that is suboptimal for this kind of job > if `eth_getBlockByHash` is featured with `withdrawals` What do you mean by this? We can decouple from Capella, especially if everyone implements engine_exchangeCapabilites. My concern is that I want to test it, ideally in a devnet first is there some estimate about how many of the validators in beacon chain have credentials with prefix 0x00? 300-310k
